name: Mekler AI
description: x402 service diagnostics, annual SEC financial facts, CSV validation, citation-source comparison, web extraction and email domain checks for agents. Retrieve six annual US-GAAP USD fields by CIK with filing links, same-filing growth checks and optional observed revisions; check supplied CSV and citations; extract public page text, rendering JavaScript in a headless browser when needed; inspect email address syntax and mail-domain DNS. Pay per call with native USDC on Base or Solana via x402, without a separate API key. Wallet-first free trials cover CSV, column-spec, citation and static-page operations.
